title: Exactly 100 years later: Filipino devotees celebrate 'Birhen ng Antipolo's' canonical coronation
summary: Reliving a defining moment in its centuries-old history, the widely venerated image of Birhen ng Antipolo (Our Lady of Antipolo) was once again crowned in a solemn ceremony at the Manila Cathedral.
